verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a first-party Exports API: you pick an export type and a date range, and the types include CUSTOMER, SCREENING_AND_MONITORING_CASES and TRANSACTION_MONITORING_CASES_AND_ALERTS. Customers can also be looked up by an external identifier, which supports reconciliation, and the OpenAPI schema covers export, case and audit resources. However, nothing shows that exports carry stable IDs or include case decision fields, and download URLs expire 5 seconds after they are issued. Missing for 10: confirmed export of decision data, documented stable identifiers within export files, explicit screening-alert export coverage, and hands-on or independent corroboration of export contents.
